description: Fix rank badge not showing + add animated shimmer effect for Diamond+ tiers + graceful degradation when ranked data fails to load
steps: Install dependencies and verify baseline build passes: run 'bun install' and 'bunx next build' in /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-league-tracker

Fix the RankBadge bug in app/components/RankBadge.tsx: The component renders correctly but the data may never arrive because the API silently swallows errors. Add defensive handling for undefined/null tier values and normalize tier to uppercase. Ensure the badge actually renders visible content even if tier is unknown.

Update app/api/riot/route.ts: Instead of silently swallowing ranked data errors, capture the error state and return a 'rankedError' field in the response so the frontend knows ranked data specifically failed (vs just not being ranked).
Update lib/types.ts: Add 'rankedError?: string' to ApiSuccessResponse interface.

Update app/components/Dashboard.tsx: Add state for rankedError. When rankedError is present, show a subtle inline message like 'Ranked data unavailable' instead of showing nothing. This implements error boundary per section - if rank data fails, match history still shows.

Add animated shimmer/glow effect to RankBadge for Diamond+ tiers (DIAMOND, MASTER, GRANDMASTER, CHALLENGER). Add a CSS keyframe animation in app/globals.css for a shimmer glow effect, then conditionally apply it in RankBadge.tsx for those high tiers.
Verify the build passes with 'bunx next build' and lint passes with 'bunx eslint .'
acceptance_criteria: RankBadge component handles edge cases: undefined tier, empty tier string, lowercase tier - all render gracefully without crashing
When ranked API call fails, Dashboard shows 'Ranked data unavailable' message instead of showing nothing
Match history still displays normally even when ranked data fails (graceful degradation)
Diamond, Master, Grandmaster, and Challenger rank badges have a visible shimmer/glow animation
verification: Run 'bunx eslint .' and confirm zero errors
Run 'bunx next build' and confirm successful build with no TypeScript or compilation errors
findings: All acceptance criteria met. Build and lint pass clean. The NotImplementedError warnings from Bun about worker_threads are pre-existing and do not affect the build outcome.
